advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Replace `finding.get('block_threshold') or DEFAULT` with `.get('block_threshold', DEFAULT)` in replayed_stored_decision so a persisted 0.0 threshold is preserved (matching production).
evidence: tier0.py:97: `block_threshold=float(finding.get("block_threshold") or decide.DEFAULT_BLOCK_THRESHOLD),`
Production preserves 0.0: coach_moves.py:197 `block_threshold = float(f.get("block_threshold", DEFAULT_BLOCK_THRESHOLD))` and criteria/model.py:69 `.get("block_threshold", DEFAULT_BLOCK_THRESHOLD)`
decide.py:64 `DEFAULT_BLOCK_THRESHOLD = 0.95`; criteria/model.py:72 min-over-criteria can yield 0.0 if any criterion carries block_threshold 0.0
BLOCK requires `priority >= block_threshold` (decide.py:653), so 0.95 vs 0.0 flips the decision
advisory.finding: replayed_stored_decision coerces a legitimately-persisted block_threshold of 0.0 to DEFAULT_BLOCK_THRESHOLD (0.95) via the `X or DEFAULT` idiom, deviating from production's `.get('block_threshold', DEFAULT)` which preserves 0.0. A finding whose persisted threshold is 0.0 (block on any priority) replays as advisory, producing a false self-check mismatch (or masking a real one) for exactly the boundary the harness exists to reproduce.
advisory.suggested_fix: Use `bt = finding.get('block_threshold'); block_threshold=float(bt if isinstance(bt, (int, float)) else decide.DEFAULT_BLOCK_THRESHOLD)`.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Decide/document whether label_proxy_metrics should score only the latest review per ticket rather than OR-ing block across all historical reviews of the ticket.
evidence: tier0.py:300-302 `blocked = any(...); by_ticket_candidate_block[tid] = by_ticket_candidate_block.get(tid, False) or blocked`

A ticket may have multiple REVIEW_RESULT events (corpus.py:295 iterates `by_type.get('REVIEW_RESULT', [])`), each producing a replayed row keyed by (ticket_id, review_event_uuid) in replay_row's output
advisory.finding: label_proxy_metrics collapses the candidate BLOCK verdict across ALL replayed rows sharing a ticket_id via OR-reduction, so a stale/earlier REVIEW_RESULT that blocked is conflated with a later clean review of the same ticket when scoring precision/recall against the ticket-level escape label.
